issues.description: sign_message and verify_signature duplicate the SigningMode-to-bytes dispatch instead of sharing one helper.
issues.detail: Both functions in the new util module switch on SigningMode to produce the bytes that are signed or verified, with subtly different branch sets. Extract one pure helper, message_bytes(mode, message) -> bytes, and call it from both sides so sign and verify cannot drift when a future CHIP mode is added.

issues.description: signing_mode_enum encodes four cases as three if/elif branches plus a silent fall-through default.
issues.detail: The helper handles three of four (is_hex, safe_mode) combinations explicitly then returns CHIP_0002 as a default for the fourth. Spell out all four branches (or use a match) so the truth table is readable without the reader enumerating it, and ideally collapse the two coupled booleans into a single signing_mode field on the request.

issues.description: verify_signature carries a stale ':param request:' docstring from the old RPC method.
issues.detail: The function now takes keyword-only fields (signing_mode, public_key, message, signature, address) but the docstring still describes a request parameter that no longer exists. Rewrite the docstring to match the new signature and state the address-binding invariant, or remove it; stale docs are worse than none.

issues.description: convert_secret_key_to_synthetic is an instance method on Wallet that uses no instance state.
issues.detail: It only forwards to calculate_synthetic_secret_key with the module-level DEFAULT_HIDDEN_PUZZLE_HASH, but callers must route through self.service.wallet_state_manager.main_wallet to reach it. Make it a module-level function (e.g. in util/signing) or a staticmethod so identity is not complected with a pure value transform.

issues.description: Local name hex_message in sign_message is misleading after extraction.
issues.detail: Inside sign_message the local is called hex_message but holds a Program tree hash or utf-8 bytes in three of four branches; the name was inherited from the old wallet method. Rename to message_to_sign to mirror verify_signature's message_to_verify and make the sign/verify symmetry visible.

issues.description: test_sign_message_by_address never asserts that verify returned isValid is True.
issues.detail: The new test calls verify_signature but does not bind the VerifySignatureResponse or assert response.isValid is True. A regression that made every signature fail verification would still let the test pass; assert the postcondition so the test actually guards the round-trip invariant.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a sensible mechanical extraction of sign_message/verify_signature into chia/wallet/util/signing.py, but it stops one step short of the cleanup that motivates it. Two structural issues dominate: the SigningMode-to-bytes dispatch is still duplicated between sign and verify, and the four-way mode is encoded as two coupled booleans (is_hex, safe_mode) decoded by a non-exhaustive if/elif with a silent fall-through default. Smaller drift includes a stale ':param request:' docstring, a pure-value method bound to Wallet for no reason, a misleading hex_message local, and a new test that forgets to assert isValid. Needs-work, small and fixable, then land it.
